text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival.
An annual event where fans are invited into Tracen Academy, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry...
Even though it's an important day for fan service, I just couldn't help making such a grave face...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I just got a little distracted by the races.
Given the time of year, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) looms just ahead.
However...
choice_data_list: Even so, let's do something fun for a change of pace today!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...That's true.
I have to make sure I don't get dragged along too much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of her earnest personality,
there are times when a Trainer needs to
make sure she takes a breather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Among the various events taking place today, the one Narita Top Road will be participating in is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hup, hah, fuh, hoh... and down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's been a while,
but my senses haven't dulled at all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now then, could everyone on "Team Top Road"
please gather around?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We're going to play in a futsal match.
And the teammates fighting alongside me are—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Lookin' forward to workin' with ya~ Um...
Is it really okay for a total beginner like me to join in?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With Meisho Doto, and then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You could say I'm somewhat experienced at this.
I used to play ball on the riverbank and all."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Though I only ever watch matches...
Huh? Does that still make me a beginner after all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle. A completely ordinary Umamusume
whose soccer experience seemed limited to just
playing a little casually.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, both of you!
I'll be right here supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best too, Class Rep!
Thanks for inviting me!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I might just drop by on my own even before being invited.
After all, I want to help you out, Madam President.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Joined by two other classmates, a team of five was formed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now then, for the position announcement.
The crucial Forward position for futsal goes to—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'd like to ask Meisho Doto-chan, please!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawawawa, me? B-B-But, I'm not very good at it though~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even in races, all I could ever do
was just watch Opera O-san, Top Road-san,
and Ayabe-san from behind...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?
Just the other day, Doto-chan—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It was your first time winning a graded race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chan isn't incompetent at all.
Her spirit of never giving up right before
the finish line is always incredible.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Please have confidence in yourself! The one best suited to be a forward on this team is definitely you, Doto-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawaaa... Hearing you say that, Top Road-san, makes me feel like it might really be trueee...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: You know, Top Road-chan is really good at speaking. Truly fitting for a class rep, you could say.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, I am simply
telling the truth.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Next, for Mirako-chan's position,
we'd like you on the left side as a midfielder, please."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot of running in clockwise circles, so
I think it will be a great fit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Circle around from the left to the right...
Yeah, got it."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Since I have experience, I'll take center back to control the game from the center.
As for you other two...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the positions for all five of them
were announced one after another—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well then, everyone—
let's do our best and aim for victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With magnificent leadership,
Narita Top Road unites the team.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: That's it! The finals are over!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: "Team Top Road" took a heartbreaking second place! They were just one step away!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work, everyone.
The ending was unfortunate, yes. But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's guts are second to none, not even the championship team.
Thank you so much for giving it your all alongside us!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm the one who should be thanking youuu.
It's all thanks to you that we made it to the finals, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Oh, that reminds me.
Does this mean our team is disbanded?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Setting aside those two classmates, Doto-chan and I rarely get the chance to do anything together with Top Road-chan, so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Like, I kinda want a parting word from the captain looking toward the future, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Words of farewell, was it?
Understood. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mirako-chan, thank you so much for running around tenaciously until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Her stamina was extraordinary, even among Umamusume.
You should definitely make good use of it in her races.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Extraordinary, really~?
Well, hearing that from Top Road-chan
kind of makes me feel like I might be...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Next is Doto-chan.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Doto-chan will become
an amazing Umamusume in the future.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"When you feel it's the decisive moment,
don't hesitate—push forward with confidence."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Without flinching when it counts most.
I kind of feel like I can do this now~

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, you can forget the futsal rules and techniques for all I care.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Let us carry forward only the feelings we learned today into the future. With that, 'Team Top Road' is disbanded!"

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone bowed their heads with joyful smiles.
Thanks to Narita Top Road,
everyone was able to make wonderful memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And at the after-party—
choice_data_list: Did you have fun, Top Road?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was a nice breather.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
may I tell you how I truly feel?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Things I couldn't say
to the rest of the team.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The truth is... I...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win, so badly.
I wanted to make everyone in the group
even happier...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I wanted them to taste the joy of victory,
but I couldn't make it happen... That's what frustrates me so much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I still have a long way to go...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I intend to move forward myself,
never forgetting what I learned today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though frustration seeps through, she nonetheless
resets her mindset and looks upward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the Fan Appreciation Festival, filled with both tears and laughter, drew to a close.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yay, Doto-chan!
Throwing your whole body into the goal—Snowman Shoot, massive success!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
That's it! The finals are over!
And the winner is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: It's "Team Top Road"!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yay! We did it, Top Road-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is all thanks to everyone!
It was a great fight and a wonderful finish.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm the one who should be thanking youuu.
It's all thanks to you that we won, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Oh, that reminds me.
Does this mean our team is disbanded?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Setting aside those two classmates, Doto-chan and I rarely get the chance to do anything together with Top Road-chan, so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Like, I kinda want a parting word from the captain looking toward the future, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Words of farewell, was it?
Understood. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mirako-chan, thank you so much for running around tenaciously until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Her stamina was extraordinary, even among Umamusume.
You should definitely make good use of it in her races.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Extraordinary, really~?
Well, hearing that from Top Road-chan
kind of makes me feel like I might be...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Next is Doto-chan.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Doto-chan will become
an amazing Umamusume in the future.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"When you feel it's the decisive moment,
don't hesitate—push forward with confidence."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Without flinching when it counts most.
I kind of feel like I can do this now~

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, you can forget the futsal rules and techniques for all I care.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Let us carry forward only the feelings we learned today into the future. With that, 'Team Top Road' is disbanded!"

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone bowed their heads with joyful smiles.
Thanks to Narita Top Road,
everyone was able to bask in the glory of victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And at the after-party—
choice_data_list: Did you have fun, Top Road?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so. We managed to pull
the whole team together nicely, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Maybe... I was able to perform
even better than in a normal race.
choice_data_list: I see, you really are cut out to be a leader.
I see, you really do have what it takes to be a leader.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Well-suited for leadership...
So you mean far beyond merely passing... is that it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no doubt about it.
Narita Top Road was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looked closely at each and every person,
offering just the right words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And raising everyone's morale,
she ultimately led them to achieve their goal."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Hearing you say that
makes me so happy, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"When it's just for myself, I sometimes spin my wheels,
but when I think about doing it for someone else,
maybe it helps me stay a bit calmer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Futsal is a team sport, while racing is individual.
Even with that difference—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Racing "for someone's sake" is likely one of the essential elements for Narita Top Road to unleash her true power.

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it is time for the folk dance.
Everyone, please get ready.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Folk dancing... So that's a thing too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! In that case, Trainer,
would you care to dance with me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's show off our peak teamwork.
Here as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: If it's just the two of us with Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wow, those two are amazing...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, completely in sync...
Could they have practiced that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Don't think about anything, just dance. That's all it takes.
We understand each other's rhythm completely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road and I
were completely as one.
